questions.q: WHITE 9 passes the ball to his goalkeeper WHITE 1, who is standing in the playing area. Because WHITE 9 is under pressure, he throws the ball too high, so that WHITE 1 must move back and enter the goal area with one foot, immediately after catching the ball. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 5.9, Rules 5:9, 6:1 and 13:1a.

questions.q: The referees give a free throw for WHITE team at the goal-area line of WHITE team. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 is standing with one foot in the goal area and one foot in the playing area. He passes the ball to WHITE 8, who scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the free throw outside the goal area of WHITE team
Free throw for BLACK team at the goal-area line of WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 5.10, Rule 5:3.

questions.q: The referee whistles because of too many steps by BLACK 21. BLACK 21 puts the ball down at the goal-area line of WHITE team. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 wants to throw the ball quickly. He supports himself with one hand on the floor in the playing area, and he has one foot on the floor in the goal area. From this position he plays the ball to WHITE 3, who starts a counter-attack that leads to a goal for WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal.
Free throw for BLACK team because of illegal free-throw execution by WHITE 12
questions.why: Correct: Repeat the free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 5.11, Rule references: 5:3, 15:1, note.

questions.q: Goalkeeper BLACK 1 has left his goal area. He jumps up in the playing area, catches a pass from a teammate while in the air, and lands with both feet inside his goal area. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 5.12, Rules 5:9 and 13:1a.

questions.q: The ball is on the floor right outside the goal area of WHITE team. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 stands inside the goal area and picks up the ball to prevent an opponent from taking it. Correct decision?
a: No intervention because it is allowed
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 5.13, Rules 5:7 and 5:8.

questions.q: The ball lies on the goal-area line. Attacker WHITE 7 picks it up and tries to score. WHITE 7 has a clear chance of scoring, when he is illegally attacked. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.1, Rules 1:3, 6:5 and 12:1.

questions.q: The ball is rolling in the goal area of WHITE team. BLACK 8 picks the ball up and scores a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.2, Rules 6:5 and 12:1.

questions.q: WHITE 3 stands with both feet in the playing area and catches the ball rebounding from his goalkeeper. When WHITE 3 is correctly obstructed by BLACK 10, he bounces the ball several times in his own goal area. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.3, Rule 6:5.

questions.q: WHITE 7 stands outside the goal area of BLACK team, but grabs the ball that is clearly in the air above the goal area and scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.4, Rule 6:5.

questions.q: WHITE 8, who is attacked correctly by several opponents, intentionally rolls the ball into his own goal area, where the ball comes to rest. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 does not pick up the ball. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.5, Rules 6:7b and 13:1a.

questions.q: WHITE 5 plays the ball into his own team’s goal area. The ball hits the goal post and rolls towards the playing area. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 picks up the ball and passes it to WHITE 7, who scores a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.6, Rules 6:7b and 13:1a.

questions.q: BLACK team has scored a goal, and WHITE 10 executes the subsequent throw-off. He does not find any other teammate available, so he surprises his goalkeeper WHITE 12 by playing the ball back to him, even though the goalkeeper is standing in his goal area. WHITE 12 takes the ball and passes it to WHITE 9. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.7, Rules 6:7b and 13:1a.

questions.q: Defender BLACK 7 sees that pivot WHITE 9 would be alone with the goalkeeper if he receives the ball. Having done the same thing earlier, he runs through the goal area to get around WHITE 9, so that he cannot receive a pass. BLACK 7 is already outside the goal-area line again, when WHITE 9 receives the ball. WHITE 9 turns around and runs straight into BLACK 7. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Progressive punishment against BLACK 7. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.8, Rules 6:2c, 8:7f, 14:1a and 16:1b.

questions.q: The ball rebounds from goalkeeper BLACK 1 to the attacking player WHITE 4, who is waiting just outside the goal-area line. To prevent a clear chance of scoring, BLACK 2 enters the goal area and prevents WHITE 4 from receiving the ball. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.9, Rule references: 6:2c, 14:1a, Clarification 6a.

questions.q: WHITE 10 passes the ball in the direction of his own goal area. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 jumps from the goal area and catches the ball in the air. WHITE 1 firmly holds on to the ball and lands outside the goal area. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.10, Rules 5:3, 5:6 and 6:7b.

questions.q: The ball is passed from WHITE 11 back into the goal area, where goalkeeper WHITE 1 jumps up and catches the ball in the air. WHITE 1 firmly holds on to the ball and lands with one foot inside the goal area and one foot outside. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.11, Rules 5:3, 5:6 and 6:7b.

questions.q: WHITE 7 from the attacking team is in possession of the ball and steps with the ball into the goal area of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.12, Rules 6:2a and 12:1.

questions.q: The ball is lying on the floor in the goal area of WHITE team. At this moment, the timekeeper whistles and explains that WHITE 5 has made a faulty substitution. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team
Free throw for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.13, Rule references: 4:5, 6:5, second paragraph, 13:3, 16:3a.

questions.q: In which of the following cases should a goalkeeper throw be given?
a: When a player of the attacking team (with the ball) touches the goal area of the opponents
When a player of the attacking team (without the ball) touches the goal area of the opponents and gains an advantage by doing so
When a player of the attacking team deflects the ball out across the outer goal line of the opponents
When a player with the ball touches the goal area of his own team
questions.why: Correct: When a player of the attacking team (with the ball) touches the goal area of the opponents; When a player of the attacking team (without the ball) touches the goal area of the opponents and gains an advantage by doing so; When a player of the attacking team deflects the ball out across the outer goal line of the opponents. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.14, Rules 6:2a and 12:1.

questions.q: WHITE team is attacking. BLACK 4 stands at the goal-area line. The ball is in the air, and BLACK 4 reaches it to direct it into the goal area. The ball is touched by goalkeeper BLACK 1 and then crosses the outer goal line. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.15, Rule 6:7b.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 12 has saved a shot and has the ball under control in his goal area. He still has the ball in his hands when the timekeeper whistles for a faulty substitution by WHITE 10. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team
Free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 10. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.16, Rules 2:8a, 4:5, 6:4, 12:1 and 13:3.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 12 jumps up in the playing area just outside his goal area, catches the ball – that has been thrown to him by WHITE 4 – in the air, and throws it over the outer goal line. He then lands inside the goal area. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Throw-in for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.17, Rules 5:3 and 6:7c.

questions.q: WHITE 9 shoots at the goal of BLACK team. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 saves the shot, and the ball rolls towards the playing area, where a player from BLACK team is ready to pick it up. As BLACK 1 was injured when saving the shot, the referees interrupt the game, while the ball is still in the goal area. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.18, Rules 6:5 and 13:4.

questions.q: The ball is rolling on the floor in the goal area of WHITE team. At this moment, the timekeeper whistles and explains that WHITE 5 has made a faulty substitution. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team
Free throw for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5; Free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.19, Rule references: 4:5, 6:5, first paragraph, 16:3a.

questions.q: WHITE 5 takes a shot on goal. The shot is blocked by goalkeeper BLACK 12 and goes in the air over the goal area in the direction of pivot WHITE 11, who is standing at the goal-area line alone and ready to catch the ball. Defender BLACK 2 jumps in the direction of the ball, and while in mid-air over the goal area, he plays the ball in the direction of the sideline. Because of glue on the ball, the ball comes to rest in the goal area without the goalkeeper touching it. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.20, Rule references: 6:7b, 13:1b:.

questions.q: Goalkeeper BLACK 1 has saved a shot and wants to pass the ball to BLACK 6, who is ready for a fast break. When BLACK 1 makes the pass, he touches the goal-area line. BLACK 6 gets the ball and scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Correction and repeated goalkeeper throw after whistle
questions.why: Correct: Goal is valid. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.21, Rules 6:1 and 1:3.

questions.q: WHITE 6 is counter-attacking. He jumps, takes a shot on goal, and lands in the goal area of BLACK team. Goalkeeper BLACK 12 blocks the shot, and the ball goes to WHITE 11, who scores a goal, while WHITE 6 is lying in the goal area between him and goalkeeper BLACK 12. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.22, Rule 6:2a.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play with an empty goal. WHITE 11 takes a shot on goal. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 saves the shot. He executes the goalkeeper throw as a shot on the empty goal. WHITE 10 tries to save the shot. He jumps from outside his own goal area and – while in the air over the goal area – touches the ball. The ball crosses the outer goal line. After touching the ball, WHITE 10 lands inside the goal area. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Throw-in for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.23, Rules 6:3 and 11:1.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play with an empty goal. WHITE 11 takes a shot on goal. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 saves the shot. He executes the goalkeeper throw as a shot on the empty goal. WHITE 10 tries to save the shot. He jumps from outside his own goal area and – while in the air over the goal area – catches the ball and lands inside the goal area with the ball in his hands. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 10. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.24, Rule references: 6:2, 8:8i, 14:1a, Clarification.

questions.q: BLACK 5 takes a shot on goal. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 saves the ball. During the save, WHITE 12 hits his head against the goalpost and falls to the floor injured. BLACK 3 catches the rebound from the goalkeeper’s save and has a clear chance of scoring at the goal-area line of WHITE team. What is the correct decision?
a: The match is restarted with a 7-metre throw for BLACK team.
The match is restarted with a free throw for BLACK team.
The referees may give permission for two persons from WHITE team to enter the court to give medical treatment for WHITE 12.
After receiving medical treatment, WHITE 12 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team.
After receiving medical treatment, WHITE 12 can continue playing without leaving the court.
questions.why: Correct: Interrupt the match immediately; The match is restarted with a free throw for BLACK team; Time-out; The referees may give permission for two persons from WHITE team to enter the court to give medical treatment for WHITE 12; After receiving medical treatment, WHITE 12 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 6.25, Rule references: 4:11, clarification 8, guideline 6:8.

questions.q: The ball is in the air going towards the sideline. WHITE 3 manages to play the ball with his hand to WHITE 7 before the ball crosses the line. While doing this, WHITE 3 crosses the sideline with one foot. WHITE 7 catches the ball and scores a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.1, Rules 7:10 and 11:1.

questions.q: A risky pass is played from BLACK 3 to BLACK 11. When the ball is in the air, BLACK 11 realises that he will not be able to catch it, so he hits the ball with his fist to feed BLACK 9, who is standing in the middle of the court. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team from BLACK 9’s position
Free throw for WHITE team from BLACK 11’s position
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.2, Rule 7:1.

questions.q: WHITE 4 catches the ball while standing. He then jumps and lands on the right foot and jumps to his left foot to throw. How many steps did WHITE 4 take?
questions.why: Correct: 2. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.3, Rule 7:3a.

questions.q: A player jumps to catch the ball passed to him by a teammate. He lands on both feet simultaneously. Then he lifts his right foot to take a step to the side and drags his left foot up to the right foot. How many steps did he take?
questions.why: Correct: 1. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.4, Rule 7:3d.

questions.q: A player catches the ball in mid-air, passed to him by a teammate. He then lands on the right foot and moves off with that foot. Then he puts the left foot down first and then the right one to throw. How many steps did he take?
questions.why: Correct: 2. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.5, Rule 7:3.

questions.q: WHITE 5 is fumbling the ball, but finally manages to get it under control. Then he takes three steps, bounces the ball once, and takes another three steps before scoring a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.6, Rules 7:3, 7:4 and 7:7.

questions.q: WHITE 5 wants to start an attack. He bounces the ball repeatedly while taking five steps. He then takes the ball up again to pass it. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.7, Rule 7:4b.

questions.q: BLACK 6 catches the ball, slips and falls. Lying on his back, he passes the ball to BLACK 9. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.8, Rule 7:6.

questions.q: WHITE 3 runs between two opponents to push the ball in the direction of his path. He grabs the ball again, before it has touched the ground. Now, there is an open space towards the goal of BLACK team. WHITE 3 bounces the ball once and score. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.9, Rules 7:7 and 13:1a.

questions.q: After bouncing the ball once, WHITE 7 wants to pass the ball to WHITE 5, but WHITE 5 is marked by an opponent. WHITE 7 becomes so confused that he drops the ball but manages to catch it again before it has touched the floor. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.10, Rules 7:7 and 13:1a.

questions.q: How is repeated passive play to be penalised?
a: Free throw and disqualification (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Free throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.11, Rules 7:7 and 13:1a.

questions.q: Following a shot on goal by WHITE 4, the ball rebounds from the goal post of BLACK team, and hits the referee who stands inside the goal area next to the goal. Consequently, the ball crosses the sideline and not the outer goal line. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Throw-in for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.12, Rules 7:9 and 11:1.

questions.q: WHITE team executes a throw-in. WHITE 5 throws the ball onto the court, where it hits the referee and crosses the goal line of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of throw-in after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.13, Rules 7:9 and 15:2.

questions.q: BLACK 3 makes a jump shot, and WHITE 9 blocks the ball. The ball falls to the floor, and WHITE 9 picks it up with both hands and starts dribbling in a counter-attack. He throws the ball into the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.14, Rules 7:4 and 8:1a.

questions.q: WHITE 5 dribbles the ball along the sideline. BLACK obstructs him correctly. To get past BLACK 2, WHITE 5 steps over the sideline with one foot during his dribbling. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.15, Rules 7:10, 8:1c and 13:1a.

questions.q: After an imprecise pass from WHITE 3 to WHITE 9, the ball rolls towards the sideline near the substitution area of WHITE team. BLACK 10 is one metre away and ready to grab the ball, when WHITE 9 dives for the ball and hits it with his fist towards the centre of the playing court back to WHITE 3. His movement then causes WHITE 9 to slide over the sideline and land outside the court. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.16, Rule 7:1.

questions.q: BLACK 7 of the attacking team assumes a position outside the court without having the ball. The referees indicate to the player that he must return to the court, but he does not react. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.17, Rule 7:10.

questions.q: A player jumps in over the goal area of the opposing team. He has full ball and body control, and he is in a good position to shoot. However, instead of shooting he turns around in mid-air and passes the ball back to a teammate, who passes the ball further. Correct decision?
a: Immediate free throw because of passive play
Immediate free throw because of unsportsmanlike conduct
questions.why: Correct: Immediate free throw because of passive play. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.18, Rule 7:12.

questions.q: WHITE 3 takes a shot on the goal of BLACK team and hits the goalpost. The ball rolls back out of the goal area. At the free-throw line, WHITE 3 and BLACK 4 dive for the ball without endangering each other. BLACK 4 manages to push the ball to BLACK 6, who starts a counter-attack and scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team or BLACK team depending on the circumstances
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.19, Rules 7:1 and 7:6.

questions.q: WHITE 10 tries to pass the ball to WHITE 8, who is at the goal-area line of BLACK team. BLACK 10 stands completely still in front of WHITE 8, when the ball hits his foot. Correct decision?
a: Decision depending on who gets the ball
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.20, Rule 7:8.

questions.q: WHITE 15 blocks a pass from BLACK 9, and the ball rolls on the floor. WHITE 15 and BLACK 9 dive for the ball. WHITE 15 catches the ball and dives on the floor. He stands up, takes three steps with the ball and plays the ball to a teammate, who scores a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.21, Rule references: 7:1, 7:3 comment.

questions.q: WHITE team is leading 24:23 in the 57th minute but has one less player on the court. The court referee has given a free throw in favour of WHITE 3. WHITE 6 tries to execute the free throw several metres away from the correct spot, even though the referee has shown the correct spot very clearly. Correct decision?
a: Correction of the position, restart signal, no other action
Correction of the position, restart signal, and referees show the forewarning signal for passive play
Correction of the position, progressive punishment against WHITE 6, restart signal, and referees show the forewarning signal for passive play
questions.why: Correct: Correction of the position, restart signal, and referees show the forewarning signal for passive play. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.22, Rule references: 7:11, Clarification 4.

questions.q: BLACK team is playing with one player less. The players of BLACK team have already assumed their positions in attack and started the build-up phase. Now, BLACK 6 and BLACK 8 decide to leave the court for a substitution. Correct decision?
a: Forewarning signal if there is no increase in tempo within 5 seconds
Immediate free throw for WHITE team because of passive play
Warning for BLACK 6 or BLACK 8 if repeated
2-minute suspension for BLACK 6 or BLACK 8 if repeated
questions.why: Correct: Forewarning signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.23, Rule references: 7:11, 7:12, Clarification 4.B.3.

questions.q: Which of the following actions nullify the forewarning signal?
a: Renewed ball possession for attacking team after goalkeeper saves a 7-metre throw
Renewed ball possession for attacking team after the ball rebounds from the crossbar or the goalpost
Forceful action before the team’s next passive actions
None of the actions under points a-d
questions.why: Correct: Renewed ball possession for attacking team after goalkeeper saves a 7-metre throw; Renewed ball possession for attacking team after the ball rebounds from the crossbar or the goalpost. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.24, Rule references: Clarification 4.C.

questions.q: WHITE team delay the execution of a throw-off. The team has already been cautioned for this type of tactical delay earlier. Correct decision?
a: Time-out; throw-off after whistle signal, immediate hand signal for passive play
Whistle signal for throw-off, immediate hand signal for passive play
Progressive punishment for the responsible team official from WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Whistle signal for throw-off, immediate hand signal for passive play. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.26, Rule references: 7:11, 7:12, Clarification 4.B.2.

questions.q: Which of the following statements regarding the correct use of the forewarning signal for passive play are correct?
a: The forewarning signal is always to be stopped when a team official from the defending team is given a progressive punishment during the course of an attack.
When the forewarning signal is shown for the first time during an attack, the arms must be taken down after about ten seconds.
The forewarning signal must be repeated as a reminder after the first interruption, if it has been shown before the interruption.
The forewarning signal is always to be stopped when a player from the defending team is given a progressive punishment during the course of an attack.
The referees must show the forewarning signal when a player has the ball clearly under control.
questions.why: Correct: The forewarning signal is always to be stopped when a team official from the defending team is given a progressive punishment during the course of an attack; The forewarning signal is always to be stopped when a player from the defending team is given a progressive punishment during the course of an attack; The referees must show the forewarning signal when a player has the ball clearly under control. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.27, Rule references: Clarification 4.

questions.q: Which of the following statements regarding passive play are correct?
a: A team must not be allowed more than five seconds to move from the build-up phase to the finishing phase.
The referees must be aware of slow and late substitutions after the throw-off has already been executed.
The referees must observe if the team is trying to increase the tempo or gain a spatial advantage during the build-up phase.
The referees must look out for passive play as soon as a team has gained ball possession in its own half of the court.
A team that has tried to make a counter-attack must be allowed a normal substitution when switching from counter-attacking to a normal build-up phase.
questions.why: Correct: The referees must be aware of slow and late substitutions after the throw-off has already been executed; The referees must observe if the team is trying to increase the tempo or gain a spatial advantage during the build-up phase; The referees must look out for passive play as soon as a team has gained ball possession in its own half of the court; A team that has tried to make a counter-attack must be allowed a normal substitution when switching from counter-attacking to a normal build-up phase. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.28, Rule references: 7:11, Clarification 4.

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball. The referees show the forewarning signal for passive play. After one pass, WHITE 5 takes a shot on goal. The shot is blocked by BLACK 2, and the ball bounces back to WHITE 5, who passes the ball to WHITE 9. How many passes have been completed?
questions.why: Correct: 3. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.29, Rule references: 7:11-12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training support “Passive play”).

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball. The referees show the forewarning signal for passive play. WHITE 9 tries to pass the ball to WHITE 2, but the pass is blocked by BLACK 8, and the ball bounces back to WHITE 9. WHITE 9 tries to break through the defence, but is rewarded a free throw. WHITE 8 executes the free throw by passing the ball to WHITE 2. How many passes have been completed?
questions.why: Correct: 2. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.30, Rule references: 7:11-12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training support “Passive play”).

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball. The referees notice a passive tendency in the play of WHITE team. The referees show the forewarning signal for passive play. BLACK team sees that the forewarning signal is shown, and they become more aggressive in defence, trying to cause a free throw. After three passes by WHITE team, BLACK team causes a free throw. Correct decision?
a: WHITE team has 4 passes left to take a shot on goal.
WHITE team has 2 passes left to take a shot on goal.
WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal.
WHITE team has to execute the free throw as a direct shot on goal.
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.31, Rule references: 7:11-12, Clarification 4.

questions.q: WHITE team is in attack. The referees notice a passive tendency in the play of WHITE team and show the forewarning signal. WHITE team passes the ball four times, before WHITE 9 takes a shot on goal. The shot is blocked by BLACK 3, and the ball goes over the sideline for a throw-in for WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: The forewarning signal is no longer valid.
WHITE team has 4 passes left to take a shot on goal.
WHITE team has 2 passes left to take a shot on goal.
WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal.
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.32, Rule references: 7:11-12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training support “Passive play”).

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball, and because of a passive tendency in the play of WHITE team the referees show the forewarning signal. After 4 passes WHITE 5 takes a shot on goal. BLACK 3 blocks the shot, and the ball returns to WHITE 5. Correct decision?
a: WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal.
Forewarning signal is no longer valid
WHITE team has no more passes before taking a shot on goal.
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team has 1 pass left to take a shot on goal; Forewarning signal continues. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.33, Rule references: 7:11-12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training support “Passive play”).

questions.q: The score is 27-27 with 20 seconds left of the match. WHITE team play without goalkeeper. The forewarning signal is shown by the referees. After three passes, WHITE 8 passes the ball to WHITE 7, who takes a shot on goal. The ball is blocked by defender BLACK 2, and the ball passes the side line. Shortly after the throw-in is executed, the whistle sounds from the table, because WHITE team have requested a team time-out. How should the match be restarted?
a: The throw must be executed as a direct shot on goal.
Besides the possibility to execute the throw as a direct shot on goal, the thrower may pass the ball to a teammate.
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Besides the possibility to execute the throw as a direct shot on goal, the thrower may pass the ball to a teammate. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.35, Rule references: 7:11, 7:12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training Support “Passive play”).

questions.q: WHITE team plays in attack. Two passes after the forewarning signal has been shown by the referees, WHITE 7 shoots on goal. The ball is blocked by BLACK 8. WHITE 8 receives the rebound and tries to shoot on goal. Again, the ball is blocked by BLACK 8. WHITE 8 receives the ball after the block and plays the ball to WHITE 6, who has a clear chance of scoring. WHITE 6 is pulled down from behind by BLACK 7 in a way that he totally loses body control. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 7 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team; Disqualification for BLACK 7 (red card shown by the referees); Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 7.36, Rule references: 2:8, 7:11, 7:12, Clarification 4, Appendix 1 (Training Support “Passive Play”).

questions.q: During a counter-attack by WHITE team, BLACK 7 enters the court as an additional player and holds WHITE 5 in such a way that the clear chance of scoring is spoiled. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 7 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of BLACK 7 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of BLACK 7 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); 7-metre throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.1, Rules 4:6, 8:10b, 14:1a and 16:6b.

questions.q: BLACK 8, who is not included in the score sheet, arrives late and runs straight from the locker room onto the court. He spoils a clear chance of scoring when pushing the jump-shooting player WHITE 6, so that he loses body control. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 8 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of BLACK 8 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
Progressive punishment against the responsible team official of BLACK team
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification of BLACK 8 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); Progressive punishment against the responsible team official of BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.2, Rules 4:3, 8:10b, 14:1a, 16:1b, 16:6a and 16:6b.

questions.q: On the way to the changing rooms (during the half-time break) team official B from WHITE team complains to the referees in an unsportsmanlike way. Team official A from WHITE team has already received a warning during the first half of the game. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for team official B from WHITE team
Disqualification of team official B from WHITE team (red card shown by the referees)
WHITE team begins the second half reduced by 1 player for 2 minutes.
No punishment possible, but written report
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for team official B from WHITE team; WHITE team begins the second half reduced by 1 player for 2 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.3, Rules 8:7a, 16:3e and 16:10.

questions.q: WHITE 6 has already been penalised twice with a 2-minute suspension. Now, WHITE 6 commits a faulty substitution. What is the decision, if he is also guilty of extremely unsportsmanlike conduct after the referees have informed him about the faulty substitution?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 6 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of WHITE 6 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 6; Disqualification of WHITE 6 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.4, Rules 4:5, 8:10a, 16:3a, 16:6d, 16:8 and 16:9c-d.

questions.q: WHITE 2 is suspended for 2 minutes, but official A sends him back onto the court after 1 minute. Before the timekeeper’s whistle WHITE 2 has already destroyed a clear chance of scoring for BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team and additional suspension for WHITE 2
7-metre throw for BLACK team, additional suspension for WHITE 2, and further reduction of WHITE team for the remainder of WHITE 2’s suspension time
7-metre throw, disqualification of WHITE 2 without written report, and further reduction of WHITE team for the remainder of WHITE 2’s suspension time (red card shown by the referees)
7-metre throw, disqualification of WHITE 2, and further reduction of WHITE team for the remainder of WHITE 2’s suspension time; written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw, disqualification of WHITE 2, and further reduction of WHITE team for the remainder of WHITE 2’s suspension time; written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.5, Rules 4:6, 8:10b, 14:1a, 16:6b and 16:8.

questions.q: During the attack of WHITE team, pivot WHITE 7, who is not in possession of the ball, blocks BLACK 4 with his trunk. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.6, Rule 8:1c.

questions.q: Wing player WHITE 4 has a clear chance of scoring. BLACK 7 tries to play the ball out of his hand, but he only hits his forearm. The ball misses the goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; No progressive punishment for BLACK 7. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.7, Rules 8:2a and 14:1a.

questions.q: WHITE 6 is in a counter-attack, goalkeeper BLACK 12 leaves his goal area to gain possession of the ball but collides with WHITE 6. However, a defender might have stopped WHITE 6 by using legal means. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 12 (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification for BLACK 12, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification for BLACK 12 (red card shown by the referees); 7-metre throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.8, Rule references: 8:5 comment, 14:1a, 16:6a, Clarification 6b.

questions.q: WHITE 2 wants to pass the ball to a teammate into the other half of the court, but his teammate is held by BLACK 5. BLACK 5 has already received a warning for running into an opponent, who did not have the ball. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 5 (red card shown by the referees)
Written report (blue card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; 2-minute suspension for BLACK 5. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.9, Rules 8:3, 13:1b and 16:3b.

questions.q: The ball is played to pivot WHITE 9, who is standing alone at the goal-area line of BLACK team. His throwing arm is then pulled back by BLACK 2. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees)
Written report (blue card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification for BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.10, Rules 8:5, 14:1a and 16:6a.

questions.q: Shortly after BLACK 9 has received a warning for pushing in the first minute of the game, BLACK 7 holds the pivot of WHITE team. There is no clear chance of scoring. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Warning for BLACK 7. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.11, Rules 8:3, 13:1b and 16:1a.

questions.q: WHITE 4 receives the ball standing at the opponents’ goal-area line with only the goalkeeper in front of him. Before WHITE 4 tries to score, BLACK 3 pulls him down in a way that WHITE 4 loses the ball. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 3 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for BLACK 3; 7-metre throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.12, Rules 8:4b, 14:1a and 16:3c.

questions.q: When must a player be disqualified (red or red and blue cards shown by the referees)?
a: For a foul that endangers the health of an opponent
For extremely unsportsmanlike conduct on or off the court
For repeated unsportsmanlike conduct on the court
For faulty substitution during a suspension (no clear chance of scoring)
questions.why: Correct: For a foul that endangers the health of an opponent; For extremely unsportsmanlike conduct on or off the court. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.13, Rules 8:5, 8:6 and 16:6a.

questions.q: WHITE team is in a counterattack. WHITE 5 wants to play the ball to WHITE 7, who is all alone at the goal-area line of BLACK team. When WHITE 5 passes the ball, team official D from BLACK team runs onto the court and catches the ball. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for team official D from BLACK team
Disqualification of team official D from BLACK team without written report (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of team official D from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
BLACK team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification of team official D from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.15, Rules 8:10b, 14:1a and 16:6b.

questions.q: Which of the following actions should be defined as extremely unsportsmanlike conduct and therefore be punished with a disqualification with a written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)?
a: Repeated defending with the foot or lower leg by a court player
A team official destroying a clear chance of scoring
Repeated delays of the game, with the purpose of wasting time
questions.why: Correct: A team official destroying a clear chance of scoring; Spitting on another person. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.16, Rules 8:10a, 8:10b and 16:6b.

questions.q: When entering the playing hall, the referees meet BLACK 4, who wears the player’s uniform, but is not included in the score sheet for the match. BLACK 4 shouts: “Not these idiots again!” After 12 minutes of the match have been played, BLACK 4 is added to the score sheet as his team’s 16th player. This is discovered by the referees. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 4 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
BLACK team continues without a reduction of players on the court
Disqualification of BLACK 4, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
BLACK team can add another player to complete the team’s allowed number of 16 players.
questions.why: Correct: BLACK team continues without a reduction of players on the court; Disqualification of BLACK 4, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.17, Rules 8:10a, 16:6b, 16:8 and 16:11b.

questions.q: After a free throw for WHITE team, team official C from BLACK team enters the court and shouts: “But that should be a free throw for us!” No team officials from BLACK team have been punished earlier in the match. Correct decision?
a: The responsible team official from BLACK team must take team official C out of the hall.
2-minute suspension for team official C from BLACK team, BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
Warning for team official C from BLACK team
questions.why: Correct: Warning for team official C from BLACK team; Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.18, Rules 8:7a and 16:1b.

questions.q: WHITE 3 receives a warning due to a foul on the court that requires progressive punishment. After restart of the game and after being substituted, WHITE 3 insults the referees from the substitutions bench. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 3 without written report (red card shown by the referees, and WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
Disqualification of WHITE 3, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees), WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
2-minute suspension for WHITE 3, and WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 3, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees), WHITE team reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.19, Rules 8:10a and 16:6b.

questions.q: During a counter-attack BLACK 9 has his shirt pulled by WHITE 4, who has already received a warning. Despite this, BLACK 9 manages to play the ball to BLACK 8, who scores a goal. The referees want to penalise WHITE 4 afterwards, but by then he is already sitting on the substitution bench. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 4, WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE 4 is not allowed to play for the next 2 minutes, but the team remains complete on the court
Disqualification for WHITE 4 (red card shown by the referees), and WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 4, WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.20, Rules 8:3 and 16:3b.

questions.q: When must a player be disqualified (red card or red and blue cards shown by the referees)?
a: For destroying a clear chance of scoring through actively blocking a shot or pass by using his foot
For faulty substitution during suspension time (no clear chance of scoring)
For not putting down the ball for a free throw against his own team (not in the last 30 seconds)
questions.why: Correct: For seriously unsportsmanlike conduct. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.21, Rules 4:6, 8:8b, 8:8f, 8:9 and 16:6b.

a: The free throw must be retaken.
Disqualification for BLACK 5 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification for BLACK 5 (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.66, Rule references: 8:11a and Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 26:26 with 4 seconds left in the match. WHITE team are in attack. BLACK 5 causes a free throw for WHITE 6. BLACK 5 immediately moves back to the correct distance. WHITE 6 executes the free throw, and the ball hits BLACK 5, who does not take an active action. The ball rebounds back to WHITE 6. At the same time, the final signal sounds. What is the correct decision?
a: No further action. The match is over
The free throw must be retaken.
questions.why: Correct: No further action. The match is over. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.67, Rule references: 2:3, 2:4, Guideline 8:11a.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 20 seconds left in the match. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 saves a shot on goal, and the ball crosses the outer goal line. The referees decide on goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. WHITE 12 wants to quickly execute the goalkeeper throw. BLACK 2 runs into the goal area and delays the execution of the throw. What is the correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Disqualification for BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification for BLACK 2 with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification for BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.68, Rule references: 2:8, 8:11a, New Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 20 seconds left in the match. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 saves a shot on goal, and the ball crosses the outer goal line. The referees decide on goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. WHITE 12 gets ready to execute the goalkeeper throw. Before the ball has left his hand, a whistle signal sounds from the timekeeper because of a faulty substitution made by BLACK team. BLACK 3 has entered the court before BLACK 11 has left it. What is the correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Free throw for WHITE team at the substitution area of BLACK team
Disqualification for BLACK 3 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification for BLACK 3 (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.69, Rule references: 2:8, 8:11a, New Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 20 seconds left in the match. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 saves a shot on goal, and the ball crosses the outer goal line. The referees decide on goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. WHITE 12 executes the throw as a pass to WHITE 9, who is standing just outside the goal area. Before the ball has crossed the goal-area line, a whistle signal sounds from the timekeeper because of a faulty substitution made by BLACK team. BLACK 3 has entered the court before BLACK 11 has left it. What is the correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team at the substitution area of BLACK team
Disqualification for BLACK 3 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Disqualification for BLACK 3 (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.70, Rule references: 2:8, 8:11a, New Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 10 seconds left in the match. WHITE team are in a counter-attack. BLACK 10 attacks WHITE 9 in a way that is dangerous to his health. Before falling, WHITE 9 plays the ball to WHITE 11. WHITE 11 takes a shot on goal, but the ball is saved by goalkeeper BLACK 12. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees); 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.71, Rule references: 2:8, 8:5, 8:11b, 14:2, New Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 10 seconds left in the match. WHITE team are in a counter-attack. BLACK 10 attacks WHITE 9 in a way that is dangerous to his health. Before falling, WHITE 9 plays the ball to WHITE 11. WHITE 11 scores a goal. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees); Goal for WHITE team; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.72, Rule references: 2:8, 8:5, 8:11b, 14:2, New Guideline.

questions.q: The score is 29:29 with 10 seconds left in the match. WHITE team are in a counter-attack. BLACK 10 attacks WHITE 9 in a way that is dangerous to his health. Before falling, WHITE 9 plays the ball to WHITE 11. WHITE 11 plays the ball to WHITE 4. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees)
Referee whistles after the pass from WHITE 11 to WHITE 4
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees); Referee whistles after the pass from WHITE 11 to WHITE 4; 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Time out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.73, Rule references: 2:8, 8:11b, Guidelines, 14:2.

questions.q: WHITE 7 is in a counterattack. He has a clear chance of scoring and takes an unhindered shot on goal. The ball hits goalkeeper BLACK 12 in the head, and he falls to the floor. The rebounding ball is recovered by WHITE 9 who has a clear chance of scoring at the goal-area line of BLACK team. At that moment, the referees whistle to call for medical treatment for goalkeeper BLACK 12. What is the correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper BLACK 12 must leave the court and can only re-enter after his team have completed 3 attacks.
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 7; Free throw for BLACK team; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.74, Rule references: 2:8, 4:11, 13:1a, Clarification 8.

questions.q: WHITE team leads by one goal with 7 seconds left until the end of the match. WHITE team are ready to execute a throw-off from the throw-off area, and the referees give the whistle signal for the execution. Instead of passing the ball to a teammate, WHITE 7 puts the ball down on the floor inside the throw-off area and walks away. No teammates are interested in entering the throw-off area to pick up the ball. What is the correct decision?
a: The referees must wait 3 seconds after the whistle signal for the execution before they can give a free throw for BLACK team.
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 7; Free-throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.75, Rules 2:8, 8:8 and 13:1a.

questions.q: BLACK 8 breaks through the defence of WHITE team and has no players between himself and the goalkeeper WHITE 1. When he is about to shoot on goal, he is pushed from the side by WHITE 7. Even if he partly loses body control, he is able to shoot hard on goal. The ball hits the head of goalkeeper WHITE 1, changes direction and goes into the goal. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 7; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.76, Rules 2:8, 8:4, 8:8d and 13:2.

questions.q: Line player BLACK 8 receives the ball. When he is trying to turn towards the goal, he is strongly held and pulled down by WHITE 7. However, he still regains full body control. Without any players between himself and the goalkeeper, he jumps above the goal area. He shoots hard with full body control. The ball hits goalkeeper WHITE 1 in the head. The head is the first point of contact with the ball. The ball changes direction and goes into the goal. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Direct 2-minute suspension for BLACK 8; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 7; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.77, Rules 2:8, 8:4, 8:8d and 13:1a.

questions.q: Wing player BLACK 3 has a clear chance of scoring and takes a shot on goal. The ball touches the side of the head of goalkeeper WHITE 1 without changing direction. The ball goes into the goal. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.78, Rule references: 2:8, 4:11, Clarification 8, 8:8d.

questions.q: Wing player BLACK 3 has a clear chance of scoring and takes a shot on goal. The ball hits the side of the head of goalkeeper WHITE 1 and changes direction. The head is the first point of contact with the ball. The ball goes into the goal. WHITE 1 falls to the floor, puts his hand on his head, and clearly needs medical assistance. What is the correct decision?
a: The referees call for medical assistance for WHITE 1 by showing hand signals 15 and 16.
After receiving medical assistance WHITE 1 must leave the court and can only re-enter after his team completed 3 attacks.
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; The referees call for medical assistance for WHITE 1 by showing hand signals 15 and 16; Direct 2-minute suspension for BLACK 3; Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.79, Rule references: 2:8, 4:11, Clarification 8, 13:1a.

questions.q: With 10 seconds left in the match, BLACK team are in attack. While the ball is in play, BLACK 10 intentionally hits WHITE 7 in the face with his elbow. WHITE 7 falls to the floor and lies there injured. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification without written report for BLACK 10 (red card shown by the referees).
Disqualification with written report for BLACK 10 (red and blue cards shown by the referees).
The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team.
The game is restarted with a 7-metre throw for WHITE team.
The referees may give permission for two persons from WHITE team to enter the court to assist WHITE 7.
After receiving medical care on the court, WHITE 7 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team.
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification with written report for BLACK 10 (red and blue cards shown by the referees); Time-out; The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team; The referees may give permission for two persons from WHITE team to enter the court to assist WHITE 7. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.80, Rule references: 2:8, 4:11, 8:6, 13:1a, Clarification 8.

questions.q: WHITE team play with empty goal. BLACK 7 intercepts a pass and takes a shot at the empty goal. WHITE 4 catches the ball while he is running just outside the goal area. He is not able to stop and enters the goal area with both feet and the ball in his hands. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team; No punishment. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 8.81, Rules 8:8i and 14:1.

questions.q: WHITE 7 is standing in the centre of defence, when BLACK 3 tries to play a bounce pass to the line player. WHITE 7 tries to stop the ball by clearly lifting his foot. While doing so he kicks the ball into the goal of WHITE team. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team; 2-minute suspension against WHITE 7. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.1, Rules 7:8, 9:1, 13:2 and 16:1b.

questions.q: A shot by WHITE 5 bounces back from the goalpost of BLACK team. It deflects off the foot of BLACK 3, who is standing in the playing area, into the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.2, Rules 7:8, 9:1 and 13:2.

questions.q: The ball has been stopped by goalkeeper WHITE 1 and bounces back from defender WHITE 3’s back, who is standing two metres inside the goal area, into the goal of WHITE team. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.3, Rules 6:3b, 9:1 and 13:2.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 1 holds the ball for four seconds in a position where three quarters of the ball have already passed the goal line. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.4, Rules 6:4, 9:1 and 12:1.

questions.q: WHITE 3 enters his team’s goal area and tries to stop a shot with his foot, but the ball deflects off his foot into the goal of WHITE team. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.5, Rules 9:1 and 14:2.

questions.q: WHITE 11 takes a lob shot over goalkeeper BLACK 1, who is standing far in front of the goal. Just before the ball crosses the goal line, the manager of BLACK team, who has been sitting in the first spectators’ row behind the goal and is not listed on the score sheet, pushes the ball away. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK team’s manager with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team; Written report. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.6, Rule references: 9:1, comment.

questions.q: The score is 25:25 with two seconds to play in the match. An official of WHITE team (home team), who is not listed on the score sheet, intercepts the ball, which is flying high in the direction of the empty goal. This action spoils a goal for BLACK team. Immediately after this action, the final signal sounds. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of the official with written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: The final score is 25:26; Written report. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.7, Rule references: 9:1, comment.

questions.q: BLACK 9 takes a 7-metre throw and scores. WHITE team immediately takes a fast throw-off after the referee’s whistle. After two passes, WHITE 4 scores a goal. At this moment, the timekeeper whistles and informs that BLACK 9, who has returned to the bench in the meantime, had 20 seconds left of a 2-minute suspension at the time of the 7-metre throw. Correct decision?
a: 7-metre throw for BLACK team must be repeated
questions.why: Correct: BLACK 9 receives additional suspension; Both goals are valid. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.8, Rules 4:6, 9:1, 9:2 and 16:3a.

questions.q: Just before the end of the match, when the result is 22:21 for his team, WHITE 5 has correctly executed a throw-off. The ball goes back in the direction of the goal of WHITE team. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 does not touch the ball, as he is in his goal area. The ball goes into the goal. The teammates of WHITE 5 had crossed the centre line after the referee’s whistle, but before the ball was played, running in the direction of the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the throw-off after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.9, Rules 9:1 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 9 tries to stop a low shot with his lower leg by clearly lifting his foot. In doing so he kicks the ball, which goes into his own goal. This is the second time that he tries to stop a shot with his leg. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team; 2-minute suspension against WHITE 9. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 9.10, Rules 8:7e, 9:1 and 16:1b.

questions.q: WHITE team wins the coin toss and decides to start with the ball. The representative of BLACK team wants to change ends. Correct decision?
a: Change ends if WHITE team agrees
questions.why: Correct: Change ends. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.1, Rule 10:1.

questions.q: WHITE team win the coin toss and want to change ends. BLACK team want WHITE team to take the throw-off. Correct decision?
a: Change ends and throw-off by BLACK team
The team representatives must come to an agreement.
questions.why: Correct: Change ends and throw-off by BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.2, Rule 10:1.

questions.q: (Without throw-off area) From where can the throw-off be executed?
a: Up to 3 metres behind the centre line in the team’s own half
Up to 3 metres across the centre line on the opponent’s half of the court
At the centre of the court with one foot on the centre line and the other foot on or behind the line, with a sideways tolerance of about 1.5 metres
questions.why: Correct: At the centre of the court with one foot on the centre line and the other foot on or behind the line, with a sideways tolerance of about 1.5 metres. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.3, Rule 10:3a.

questions.q: (Without throw-off area) The score is 15:15, and just before the end of the game, BLACK team score to make it 15:16. WHITE team want to quickly take the throw-off. The player with the ball stands at the centre of the court with one foot in front of the centre line and one foot behind the line. Correct decision?
a: Correction; then whistle signal for executing the throw-off
Position is correct; whistle signal for executing the throw-off
Time-out; correction; whistle signal for executing the throw-off
questions.why: Correct: Correction; then whistle signal for executing the throw-off. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.4, Rules 10:3a, 15:1 and 15:6.

questions.q: WHITE team is about to execute a throw-off. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 is not yet in his goal area. The court referee still whistles for the match to begin, and WHITE 9 immediately scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team from the centre line
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.5, Rules 9:1, 10:4 and 15:2.

questions.q: (Without throw-off area) Which of the following statements about the throw-off are correct?
a: The throw-off must be taken from the centre of the court within three seconds after the whistle signal and must be thrown into the opponents’ half of the court.
A goal against the opponents can be scored directly from a throw-off.
Illegal positions of the defending team must be corrected.
If the thrower dribbles the ball after the whistle signal for executing the throw-off, then a free throw must be given to the opponents.
The teammates of the thrower are allowed to cross the centre line, before the throw has been taken.
questions.why: Correct: A goal against the opponents can be scored directly from a throw-off; If the thrower dribbles the ball after the whistle signal for executing the throw-off, then a free throw must be given to the opponents; The teammates of the thrower are allowed to cross the centre line, before the throw has been taken. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.6, Rules 10:3a, 15:2, 15:3 and 15:4.

questions.q: (Without throw-off area) BLACK 6 stands for a throw-off in the centre of the court with one foot on the centre line and one foot in his team’s half of the court. The referee whistles. Before the ball has left his hand, the thrower runs over the centre line. At the time of the whistle, there were still players from WHITE team in BLACK team’s half of the court. Correct decision?
a: Correction of the positions of WHITE team and repeated throw-off after whistle signal
Correction of the position of BLACK 6 and repeated throw-off after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.7, Rules 10:3a and 15:7.

questions.q: (With throw-off area) WHITE team scored a goal. BLACK team want to execute a fast throw-off. BLACK 9 is in a correct position inside the throw-off area. After the referees whistled for the execution, BLACK 9 takes 6 steps with the ball inside the throw-off area. Within 3 seconds after the whistle signal for the execution of the throw-off, BLACK 9 throws the ball into the empty goal of WHITE team. What is the correct decision?
a: Correction, and new throw-off after whistle signal from the referees.
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.8, Rules 10:3b and 15:5b.

questions.q: (With throw-off area) BLACK team want to execute a fast throw-off from the throw-off area. At the same time as BLACK 8 is running with his body and the ball completely inside the throw-off area, WHITE 7 is also inside the throw-off area, running in the direction of his own goal. With no teammates in the direction of WHITE 7, BLACK 8 throws the ball into the back of WHITE 7. WHITE 7 is inside the throw-off area, when the ball hits him. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Direct 2-minute suspension for BLACK 8. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.10, Rules 8:8, 10:3b and 13:1a.

questions.q: (With throw-off area) Which of the following statements regarding the throw-off area are incorrect?
a: The whistle signal for the execution of the throw-off can be given when the thrower has a part of the body inside the throw-off area.
There is no restriction regarding the positions of the teammates of the thrower during the execution of a throw-off.
The thrower is allowed to step outside the throw-off area during the execution of the throw-off.
A player from defending team is allowed to intercept the ball after the execution, even if the ball still is inside the throw-off area.
The thrower is not allowed to bounce the ball after the whistle signal for the execution.
questions.why: Correct: The whistle signal for the execution of the throw-off can be given when the thrower has a part of the body inside the throw-off area; There is no restriction regarding the positions of the teammates of the thrower during the execution of a throw-off; The thrower is allowed to step outside the throw-off area during the execution of the throw-off; A player from defending team is allowed to intercept the ball after the execution, even if the ball still is inside the throw-off area. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.11, Rule references: 10.3b.

questions.q: (With throw-off area) WHITE team plays with 7 court players and scores a goal. BLACK team wants to execute a fast throw-off. BLACK 6 is inside the throw-off area with his entire body and the ball. The referees whistle for the execution. WHITE 8 clearly enters the throw-off area with active arms trying to block the ball and interferes with the execution. Even so, BLACK 6 who has his entire body and the ball inside the throw-off area executes the throw-off as a shot at the empty goal. The ball crosses the outer goal line. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for WHITE 8 (red card shown by the referees).
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; Time-out; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 8. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.12, Rule references: 2:8, 8:8g, 10:3b, 14:1a, Clarification 6.

questions.q: (With throw-off area) Which of the following statements about the throw-off area are correct?
a: The throw-off is to be executed within 3 seconds of the whistle signal for the execution.
A throw-off can lead to a goal for the executing team.
In connection with a throw-off, wrong positions of defending players must be corrected.
If the thrower jumps after the whistle signal for the execution of the throw, the correct decision is free throw for the opponents.
The teammates of the thrower are not allowed to cross the centre line at any time before the whistle signal for the execution of the throw.
questions.why: Correct: The throw-off is to be executed within 3 seconds of the whistle signal for the execution; A throw-off can lead to a goal for the executing team; If the thrower jumps after the whistle signal for the execution of the throw, the correct decision is free throw for the opponents. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 10.13, Rules 10:3b and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 3 is executing a throw-in from a position two metres outside the sideline. Correct decision?
a: No decision required, as this is allowed
Repeat the throw-in without whistle signal
Repeat the throw-in after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repeat the throw-in after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.1, Rules 11:4, 15:1 and 15:5.

questions.q: BLACK 4 stands with one foot on the sideline and the other foot in the playing area. He executes a throw-in and scores a goal directly. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the throw-in for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.2, Rules 11:4 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 6 executes a throw-in standing with one foot inside the court and the other foot one metre outside the sideline. He throws the ball into the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repeated throw-in for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repeated throw-in for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.3, Rules 11:4, 15:1 and 15:5.

questions.q: WHITE 11 takes a shot on goal. The ball rebounds from the crossbar and hits equipment, which hangs from the ceiling over the goal area of BLACK team. From there the ball falls down into the arms of goalkeeper BLACK 1. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Throw-in for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Throw-in for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.4, Rule 11:1.

questions.q: During the execution of throws following an interruption of the game, when is the defending team allowed to be closer than 3 metres from the ball?
a: As soon as the referee has given the signal for the execution of the throw
When the ball has left the hand of the player executing a free throw
In case of a free throw or throw-in, when the players are positioned at their own goal-area line
During the execution of a goalkeeper throw or a throw-off, when the defending player is standing outside the goal area or the throw-off area.
questions.why: Correct: When the ball has left the hand of the player executing a free throw; In case of a free throw or throw-in, when the players are positioned at their own goal-area line; During the execution of a goalkeeper throw or a throw-off, when the defending player is standing outside the goal area or the throw-off area. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.5, Rules 11:5, 13:8 and 15:4.

questions.q: WHITE 5 fails to catch a pass. He runs after the ball and stops it before it crosses the sideline, but he himself cannot avoid crossing the sideline afterwards. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 11.6, Rule 11:1.

questions.q: While executing a goalkeeper throw, goalkeeper WHITE 1 touches his goal-area line with one foot. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw is to be retaken after whistle signal
Let the game continue without interruption
questions.why: Correct: Let the game continue without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.1, Rules 1:3 and 12:2.

questions.q: After the whistle for the execution of a 7-metre throw, goalkeeper WHITE 12 steps on the goalkeeper’s restraining line with one foot. The 7-metre throw goes over the crossbar. Correct decision?
a: 7-metre throw is to be retaken after whistle signal
Since there is no goal, the game continues with a goalkeeper throw.
The position of the goalkeeper is correct.
questions.why: Correct: Since there is no goal, the game continues with a goalkeeper throw; The position of the goalkeeper is correct. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.2, Rules 1:3, 12:1 and 14:9.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 1 stops a shot and dives for the ball, which rolls in the goal area towards the playing area. BLACK 7 is unmarked and ready to pick up the ball. At the very last moment, WHITE 1 uses his hand to hit the ball over the outer goal line. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.3, Rule 12:1.

questions.q: While executing a goalkeeper throw, goalkeeper WHITE 12 drops the ball. The ball hits his foot. From there the ball crosses the goal-area line into the playing area. WHITE 12 runs after the ball, picks it up and returns to his goal area to repeat the goalkeeper throw. Correct decision?
a: Correction, goalkeeper throw after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Correction, goalkeeper throw after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.4, Rules 12:2 and 15:5b.

questions.q: When is a goalkeeper throw considered as executed, so that the ball may be played by a court player?
a: When the ball is still in the air above the goal area
When the ball has left the hand of the goalkeeper, passed the goal-area line and entered the playing area
When the ball has left the hand of the goalkeeper
When a teammate of the goalkeeper has touched the ball
questions.why: Correct: When the ball has left the hand of the goalkeeper, passed the goal-area line and entered the playing area. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.5, Rule 12:2.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 12 is executing a goalkeeper throw. BLACK 10, who is standing outside the goal-area line, legally tries to gain possession of the ball. He succeeds and scores a goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.6, Rule 12:2.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 12 stops a shot, deflecting the ball across the outer goal line next to the goal. Which hand signals should the goal-line referee show, if necessary?
a: First number 9 (free-throw direction), then number 8 (goalkeeper throw)
First number 8 (goalkeeper throw), then number 9 (free-throw direction)
questions.why: Correct: Number 8 (goalkeeper throw). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.7, Rule references: 12:1 – Hand signals.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 1 loses the ball while executing a goalkeeper throw. The ball bounces in the direction of the playing area, where BLACK 6 is waiting for the ball. WHITE 2 dives over the goal area and pushes the ball, which is in the air, over the sideline. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.8, Rule 12:2.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the goalkeeper throw are correct?
a: The goalkeeper throw is considered as taken when the ball has left the goalkeeper’s hand.
The opponents must keep a distance of 3 metres.
The goalkeeper throw is considered as taken when the ball has left the hand of the goalkeeper and has passed the goal-area line.
The opponents are allowed to stand directly outside the goal-area line.
questions.why: Correct: The goalkeeper throw is considered as taken when the ball has left the hand of the goalkeeper and has passed the goal-area line; The opponents are allowed to stand directly outside the goal-area line. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.9, Rule 12:2.

questions.q: There is a goalkeeper throw for BLACK team. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 is in a hurry, because his team is behind in the game. While executing the goalkeeper throw, the ball slides out of his hand and goes to BLACK 6, who is still in the goal area. BLACK 6 rolls the ball back to BLACK 1 using his foot. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.10, Rule 12:2.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the goalkeeper throw are correct?
a: The players from the opponents’ team must remain outside the free-throw line until the ball is in play.
The players from the opponents’ team must remain outside the goal-area line and 3 metres away from the position where the goalkeeper executes the goalkeeper throw.
The players from the opponents’ team are allowed to touch the ball before it has crossed the goal-area line.
The goalkeeper cannot score an own goal when he is executing a goalkeeper throw.
The goalkeeper cannot score a direct goal against the opponents with a goalkeeper throw.
While executing a goalkeeper throw, the goalkeeper is not allowed to touch the goal-area line.
questions.why: Correct: The goalkeeper cannot score an own goal when he is executing a goalkeeper throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 12.11, Rules 9:1, 12:2 and 15:2.

questions.q: There is a free throw for WHITE team. Before WHITE 5 can pick up the ball, BLACK 6 picks it up, puts it under his arm and runs towards his goal. After a few steps, he rolls the ball back to WHITE 5. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for BLACK 6; Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.1, Rules 8:8b, 13:5, 15:5b and 16:3f.

questions.q: BLACK 7 is in possession of the ball and tries to start a counter-attack but is held by WHITE 17. The referee is just about to whistle, but plays advantage, as BLACK 8 has just received the ball and takes a shot on goal of WHITE team. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 saves the shot and wants to start a counter-attack. Both teams have already received three warnings each earlier in the game. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 17; Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.2, Rules 2:8a, 8:3, 13:2 and 16:3b.

questions.q: WHITE team receives a free throw. BLACK 6 is in possession of the ball. He brings the ball with him, four metres from the place where the free-throw is to be executed. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 6 (red card shown by the referees)
Free throw for WHITE team from the place of the infraction that has led to the free throw
Free throw for WHITE team from the place where the ball is
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for BLACK 6; Free throw for WHITE team from the place of the infraction that has led to the free throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.3, Rule references: 8:8b, 13:5, 13:6 comment, 16:3f.

questions.q: A free throw is awarded against WHITE 4, who then takes the ball, crosses the goal area and puts the ball down. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 4; Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.4, Rules 8:8b, 13:5 and 16:3f.

questions.q: WHITE 5 is in possession of the ball, when official B from WHITE team complains about the referees. The referees whistle, and the time is stopped. The referees warn official B from WHITE team. How should the game be resumed?
a: Free throw after whistle signal for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team
Free throw after whistle signal for WHITE team at the substitution area of WHITE team
Free throw after whistle signal for WHITE team, executed from the place where the ball was when the game was interrupted
Throw-in for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Free throw after whistle signal for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.5, Rules 8:7a, 13:1a, 13:6 and 16:1b.

questions.q: The game is interrupted by a whistle from the court referee, even though there has been no violation of the rules by any of the teams. No team time-out has been called. BLACK 13 has thrown the ball in the direction of the goal of WHITE team immediately prior to the whistle signal from the court referee. After the whistle signal, the ball goes into the goal without a chance for goalkeeper WHITE 1 to save it. How should the game be resumed?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.6, Rule 13:4a.
