questions.q: WHITE 7 is in a counterattack. With one player from BLACK team between him and the goalkeeper, he shoots on goal and hits goalkeeper BLACK 12 in the head with the ball. BLACK 12 collapses. The ball rebounds to WHITE 9, who is standing alone at the goal-area line. WHITE 9 throws the ball in the direction of the empty goal. Just before the ball crosses the goal line, the referee whistles and interrupts the game. Goalkeeper BLACK 12 needs medical care on the court. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
BLACK 12 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team.
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.7, Rule references: 4:11, 8:8d, 13:4b, Clarification 2 and 8.

questions.q: There is a free-throw decision for BLACK 9, but WHITE 5 is still in possession of the ball. WHITE 5 moves towards one of the referees and politely gives the ball to him. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5 and free throw for BLACK team from the spot where the ball is now
Warning for WHITE 5 and free throw for BLACK team from the spot where the ball is now
2-minute suspension for WHITE 5 and free throw for BLACK team from the spot where the foul was committed
Warning for WHITE 5 and free throw for BLACK team from the spot where the foul was committed
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5 and free throw for BLACK team from the spot where the foul was committed. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.8, Rule references: 8:8b, 13:5, 13:6 comment, 16:3f.

questions.q: WHITE 5 makes a faulty substitution after the referees have just awarded a 7-metre throw for WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: Warning for the responsible team official from WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.9, Rules 4:5, 13:3 and 16:3a.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the place of execution of a free throw are correct?
a: If the ball is not put down immediately after the free-throw decision, the opponents are allowed to execute the free throw from the place where the ball is.
After a faulty substitution, the free throw can be taken from where the ball is, instead of at the substitution area, if this is advantageous to the team executing the throw.
After passive play, the free throw is always taken from the place where the ball was when the free throw was given.
For a free throw from the centre line, the tolerance to the side is about the same as in case of a throw-off.
questions.why: Correct: After a faulty substitution, the free throw can be taken from where the ball is, instead of at the substitution area, if this is advantageous to the team executing the throw; After passive play, the free throw is always taken from the place where the ball was when the free throw was given; For a free throw from the centre line, the tolerance to the side is about the same as in case of a throw-off. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.10, Rule references: 7:11, 13:6, 13:6 comment.

questions.q: BLACK 11 has the ball in attack and tries to go around WHITE 2. Because of a whistle signal from the spectators’ area, WHITE 2 stops defending. BLACK 11 is now free to shoot. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; consultation with the timekeeper; Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.11, Rule 13:4a.

questions.q: WHITE team has the ball at the free-throw line of BLACK team. Official A from BLACK team protests so strongly against a referee decision that the referees interrupt the game. Correct decision?
a: Progressive punishment for official A from BLACK team
Free throw for WHITE team at the substitution area of BLACK team
Free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team
questions.why: Correct: Progressive punishment for official A from BLACK team; Free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.12, Rule references: 8:7, 13:6, Substitution Area Regulations 5+6.

questions.q: BLACK 6 receives a warning. When whistling for the execution of the subsequent free throw for WHITE team, the court referee does not see WHITE 11, who is between the goal-area line and the free-throw line. WHITE 11 receives the ball and has a clear chance of scoring. The goal-line referee noticed the situation. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the free throw after correction and whistle signal
The goal-line referee decides on a free throw for BLACK team.
The goal-line referee gives WHITE 11 a warning.
questions.why: Correct: Repeat the free throw after correction and whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.13, Rules 13:7, 15:1 and 15:5b.

questions.q: WHITE team are in possession of the ball. BLACK team have taken their positions in defence. WHITE 8 is running close to the sideline. WHITE 4 passes the ball in the direction of WHITE 8. WHITE 8 collides with a photographer, who is walking between the stands and the court and touching the sideline. WHITE 8 fails to catch the ball and loses body control. Before the referees interrupt the game, the ball passes the sideline. What is the correct decision?
a: The game is restarted with a throw-in for BLACK team.
The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team.
Note in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation.
questions.why: Correct: The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team; Time-out; Note in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.14, Rule 13:4.

questions.q: BLACK team are in attack. The referees give a free throw to BLACK 2. Before BLACK 2 can execute the free throw, BLACK 11 pulls WHITE 8 down. What is the correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Disqualification for BLACK 11 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal; Time-out; Direct 2-minute suspension for BLACK 11. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 13.15, Rules 8:3, 8:4 and 13:3.

questions.q: There is a throw-in for BLACK team. BLACK 7 executes the throw-in correctly and notices that goalkeeper WHITE 12 is standing outside his goal area. BLACK 7 throws the ball directly in the direction of the empty goal. Court player WHITE 3 enters the goal area and stops the ball. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 3. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.2, Rules 8:8i, 14:1a and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 4 executes a 7-metre throw and hits the goalpost. The ball bounces back to WHITE 4 without touching any teammate or opponent. He throws the ball into the goal. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.3, Rule 14:6.

questions.q: WHITE 3 moves around BLACK 4 at the free-throw line of BLACK team. After taking three steps, he wants to take a shot on goal but is pushed by BLACK 4. Immediately after taking a fourth step, he scores a nice goal. No other player from BLACK team would have been able to intervene. Correct decision?
a: Advantage and therefore goal for WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Progressive punishment against BLACK 4; 7-metre throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.4, Rules 8:3c, 14:1a and 16:1a.

questions.q: WHITE 9 executes a 7-metre throw, and the ball enters the goal. However, before the ball left the thrower’s hand, WHITE 4 had crossed the free-throw line. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the throw and warning for WHITE 4
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.5, Rules 13:1a, 14:7 and 15:7.

questions.q: BLACK 2 gets ready to execute a 7-metre throw after the referee’s whistle signal. At that moment, WHITE 5 crosses the free-throw line. Despite of WHITE 5’s action, BLACK 2 scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Goal and disqualification of WHITE 5 (red card shown by the referees)
Repeated 7-metre throw and disqualification of WHITE 5
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.6, Rule 14:8.

questions.q: While WHITE 6 is in possession of the ball and ready to execute a 7-metre throw, official A from BLACK team calls goalkeeper BLACK 12 to come off and be replaced. BLACK 12 is ready to follow this instruction. Correct decision?
a: Warning for official A from BLACK team
Warning for official A from BLACK team and BLACK 12
questions.why: Correct: Warning for BLACK 12. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.7, Rules 14:10 and 16:1b.

questions.q: WHITE 4 has taken a shot on BLACK team’s goal. The ball hits the goalpost and bounces back towards the playing area. WHITE 6 stands alone at the goal-area line and is ready to catch the ball. BLACK 4 clearly enters the goal area in order to push the ball over his team’s outer goal-line. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.8, Rule references: 6:2c, 14:1a, Clarification 6.

questions.q: WHITE 3 is executing a 7-metre throw. WHITE 5 crosses the free-throw line after the referee’s whistle, but before the ball has left WHITE 3’s hand. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.9, Rules 13:1a, 14:7 and 15:7.

questions.q: WHITE 9 is standing completely unmarked at the goal-area line of the opponents, ready to receive the ball. This is noticed by WHITE 10, who plays a bounce pass through the goal area towards WHITE 9. This is noticed by BLACK 3, who clearly enters his own goal area to stop the ball, standing with both feet in the goal area. It is the second time in the game that he takes this action. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Progressive punishment for BLACK 3. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.10, Rule references: 8:7f, 14:1a, 16:1b, Clarification 6a.

questions.q: Line player BLACK 10 legally blocks WHITE 2. When BLACK 10 gets ready to make his move, BLACK 4 plays a bounce pass into the open space where BLACK 10 could be able to break through. Before BLACK 10 can receive the ball, he is held back by WHITE 2, who grabs his shirt. Correct decision?
a: 7-metre throw for BLACK team, regardless of the positions of the opponents
7-metre throw for BLACK team, if no other player from WHITE team could legally stop BLACK 10 from shooting
Mandatory disqualification of WHITE 2 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team, if no other player from WHITE team could legally stop BLACK 10 from shooting; Progressive punishment for WHITE 2. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.11, Rule references: 8:2c, 14:1a, Clarification 6a.

questions.q: WHITE 3 is in possession of the ball, running towards the goal of BLACK team in a counterattack resulting in a clear chance of scoring. While he executes a jump shot, there is a whistle signal from a spectator that distracts WHITE 3, so that he does not take a shot on goal. Instead, he stops with the ball in the goal area. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation.
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.12, Rule 14:1c.

questions.q: WHITE team is running in a counter-attack, and the score is 26:26. WHITE 5 gets ready to take a shot on goal from the goal-area line of BLACK team. At the time, there is a whistle signal from the timekeeper, who indicates that the game is over. The referees determine that 20 seconds remain to be played. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team at the timekeepers table.
Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation.
Free throw for WHITE team from where the ball was when the whistle signal came.
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.13, Rule references: 2:3, 14:1b, Clarification 6a.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the execution of a 7-metre throw are correct?
a: The player executing the throw is allowed to stand up to one metre behind the 7-metre line.
The referees must give a time-out, if the defending team is changing goalkeepers.
The goalkeeper shall be given a personal punishment, if he repeatedly crosses the goalkeeper’s restraining line.
The players of the defending team must always be 3 metres away from the thrower.
questions.why: Correct: The player executing the throw is allowed to stand up to one metre behind the 7-metre line. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.14, Rules 14:3, 14:5, 14:8 and 14:9.

questions.q: WHITE 5 is in possession of the ball and jumps from the right corner into the goal area of BLACK team. He then collides with BLACK 11, who is standing with his arms up about 50cm inside the goal area. BLACK 11 has done this for the third time in the game. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for WHITE team; 2-minute suspension for BLACK 11. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.15, Rules 6:2c, 8:7f, 14:1a and 16:3a.

questions.q: WHITE 6 is running in a counter-attack and has a clear chance of scoring, when the lights go out in the hall. Which of the following statements are correct?
a: The referees wait for the result of the clear scoring chance.
The referees interrupt the match immediately and give a time-out.
After the lights are functioning again, the game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team.
After the lights are functioning again, the game is restarted with a 7-metre throw for WHITE team.
Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation.
questions.why: Correct: The referees interrupt the match immediately and give a time-out; After the lights are functioning again, the game is restarted with a 7-metre throw for WHITE team; Statement in the match report in conformity with the regulations of the respective federation. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.16, Rule references: 14:1c, Clarification 2a.

questions.q: While WHITE 3 is executing a 7-metre throw, WHITE 5 crosses the free-throw line after the referee’s whistle signal, but before the ball has left the thrower’s hand. Goalkeeper BLACK 1 saves the shot. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the 7-metre throw for WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.17, Rules 6:4, 12:1, 13:2 and 14:7.

questions.q: WHITE 2 is ready to execute a 7-metre throw. The court referee whistles, but WHITE 2 drops the ball to the floor. BLACK 3 immediately picks up the ball and plays it to BLACK 2, who scores a goal in a counter-attack. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.18, Rules 13:2, 14:4 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 6 has the ball at the free-throw line of BLACK team and is brought down through a reckless foul by BLACK 5. At the same time, BLACK 8 stands at the goal-area line of BLACK team between his own goal and WHITE 6. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 5 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Disqualification of BLACK 5 without written report (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.19, Rule references: 8:5, 13:1b, Clarification 6.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play 7 against 6 with empty goal. BLACK 8 intercepts a pass. BLACK 8 dribbles the ball, and before he can get into position to take a shot on goal, he is attacked by WHITE 3, who manages to hold him shortly. Meanwhile, goalkeeper WHITE 12 enters the goal area again after a correct substitution with WHITE 7. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.20, Rule references: 8:2, 8:3, Clarification 6c, New Guideline.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play 7 against 6 with empty goal. BLACK 5 intercepts a pass. BLACK 5 immediately clearly tries to take a direct shot on the empty goal. In that moment, he is pushed from behind by WHITE 6, so that he partially loses body control and his shot misses the goal. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for WHITE 6 (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; Time-out; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 6. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.21, Rule references: 2:8, 8:4e, 14:1, Clarification 6c, New Guideline.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play 7 against 6 with empty goal. WHITE 11 misses a pass, and the ball crosses the sideline to a throw-in for BLACK team. BLACK 9 takes the ball and executes the throw-in as an attempt to shoot the ball directly into the empty goal. The ball is blocked by WHITE 4, who is standing too close during the execution of the throw. What is the correct decision?
a: Correction of the position of WHITE 4
Repeated throw-in for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; Direct 2-minute suspension for WHITE 4. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.22, Rule references: 8:8g, 14:1, Clarification 6c, New Guideline.

questions.q: WHITE team are in attack and play 7 against 6 with empty goal. The referees call for an offensive foul against WHITE 7. BLACK 8 gets possession of the ball and is ready to execute the free throw as an attempt to shoot the ball into the empty goal. While doing so and before the ball has left his hand, he is held and pulled down from behind by WHITE 7 in a way that he partially loses his body control. Shortly after that, goalkeeper WHITE 16 enters his goal area after a correct substitution with WHITE 2. What is the correct decision?
a: Disqualification for WHITE 7 (red card shown by the referees)
Repeated free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 7; Time-out; 7-metre throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.23, Rule references: 2:8, 8:4b, 14:1, Clarification 6c, New Guideline.

questions.q: WHITE team are playing without a goalkeeper. BLACK 9 intercepts a pass and takes a shot on the empty goal. WHITE 4 jumps from outside the goal area, and – while in the air over the goal area – catches the ball and lands inside the goal area with the ball in his hands. What is the correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: 7-metre throw for BLACK team; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 4. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 14.24, Rules 8:8i and 14:1.

questions.q: When carrying out a goalkeeper throw, goalkeeper WHITE 13 swings back the ball in a way that it goes beyond the goal line between the goalposts. Correct decision?
a: Goalkeeper throw for WHITE team with whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.1, Rules 12:2 and 15:2.

questions.q: 20 seconds before the end of the match, WHITE team is leading 20:19. Goalkeeper WHITE 12 takes his time executing a goalkeeper throw, bouncing the ball back and forth in the goal area. Correct decision?
a: Show the forewarning signal for passive play
questions.why: Correct: Whistle signal for goalkeeper throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.2, Rules 5:2, 12:2 and 15:5b.

questions.q: The referees have given a free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team. When all the players have assumed their correct positions, the referee whistles. Before the ball has left the thrower’s hand, two of his teammates cross the free-throw line of WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the free throw for BLACK team
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Without restart signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.3, Rules 13:1a, 13:7 and 15:7.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 12 is standing in the goal area with the ball in his hand and ready to execute a goalkeeper throw. BLACK 6 plays the ball away from WHITE 12 with an open hand. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal; 2-minute suspension for BLACK 6. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.4, Rules 12:1, 12:2, 15:5, 15:9 and 16:1a.

questions.q: A throw-in is awarded to WHITE team. WHITE 8 executes the throw-in as a direct shot on goal. The ball hits the goalpost and bounces back to WHITE 8, who catches the ball and scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Throw-in is retaken after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.5, Rule 15:2.

questions.q: Goalkeeper BLACK 12 has saved a shot on goal. He wants to immediately start a counter-attack, but drops the ball in a way that it crosses the goal line into the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the goalkeeper throw after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repeat the goalkeeper throw after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.6, Rules 12:1, 12:2 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 6 executes a throw-in in the direction of his goalkeeper. Goalkeeper WHITE 1 notices the ball too late, and the ball crosses the goal line. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the throw-in for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.7, Rules 9:1 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 7 executes a throw-in, and the ball hits the referee. WHITE 7 picks up the ball again and throws it into the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the throw-in after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.8, Rules 7:9, 13:1a and 15:2.

questions.q: There is a free throw for WHITE team. When everyone stands correctly, WHITE 10 puts the ball down to give some instructions. BLACK 7 quickly takes the ball and starts a counter-attack. Correct decision?
a: Repeat free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Free throw for WHITE team, warning for BLACK 7
Free throw for WHITE team, 2-minute suspension for BLACK 7
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.9, Rule 15:2.

questions.q: BLACK 9 wants to execute a free throw, but WHITE 11 is only two metres away from the ball and tries to delay the throw. Correct decision?
a: Personal punishment against WHITE 11, free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Correct the position of WHITE 11 and free throw after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Personal punishment against WHITE 11, free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.10, Rules 15:5b, 15:9, 16:1a and 16:3b.

questions.q: There is a free throw for BLACK team at the free-throw line of WHITE team. The referee overlooks that BLACK 8 is in a position between the free-throw line and the goal-area line. BLACK 8 receives the ball and scores. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repeat the free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.11, Rules 13:7, 15:5b and 15:7.

questions.q: Goalkeeper BLACK 12 executes a goalkeeper throw towards the goal of WHITE team. No player from either team touches the ball, and it enters the goal of WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: Warning for BLACK 12 for unsportsmanlike conduct
questions.why: Correct: Goal for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.12, Rule 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE 5 has already received a warning and two 2-minute suspensions. When BLACK team is carrying out a free throw, he interferes with the execution of the throw by not keeping his distance. This is the first time he does that. Correct decision?
a: Third 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5 and disqualification (red card shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Third 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5 and disqualification (red card shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.13, Rules 8:7c, 15:4, 15:9, 16:3d, 16:5 and 16:6d.

questions.q: Shortly before the end of the game, WHITE team is leading 24:23. A free throw is awarded for WHITE team about one metre outside the free-throw line of BLACK team. All players are in a correct position, and the referee whistles for the execution of the free throw. WHITE 10, who is executing the free throw, takes one step before the ball has left his hand. Correct decision?
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.14, Rules 13:7 and 15:7.

questions.q: WHITE 14 wants to execute a free throw without whistle signal at the free-throw line of BLACK team. He and his teammates are standing in correct positions. Before the ball has left the hand of WHITE 14, both WHITE 13 and WHITE 15 run across the free-throw line towards the goal-area line. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Correction; Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.15, Rules 13:3, 15:1 and 15:7.

questions.q: Goalkeeper BLACK 1 is executing a goalkeeper throw. The ball touches the referee and goes back to BLACK 1, who in the meantime has left the goal area. Correct decision?
a: Repeat the goalkeeper throw after whistle signal
Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.16, Rules 12:2, 13:1a and 15:2.

questions.q: While executing a free throw, BLACK 11 swings back his arm while moving the ball completely over the sideline. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team, verbal caution for BLACK 11
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.17, Rules 15:1 and 15:2.

questions.q: Goalkeeper WHITE 1 stops the ball just in front of the goal line. When he tries to pass the ball to WHITE 4, the ball falls out of his hand and into his own goal. Correct decision?
a: Repeated goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repeated goalkeeper throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.18, Rules 6:4, 12:1, 12:2 and 15:2.

questions.q: WHITE team has a throw-off. The court referee gives the whistle signal for the execution. WHITE 13 takes the ball out of the hand of WHITE 9, who was standing ready to execute the throw. WHITE 13 does this because he saw that WHITE 7 and WHITE 3 are running into the half of the opponents and are in favourable positions. WHITE 13 throws the ball to WHITE 7, who scores a goal. Correct decision?
a: Correction, repetition of the throw-off for WHITE team
Verbal caution for WHITE 7 and WHITE 13
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.19, Rules 15:2 and 15:7.

questions.q: (Without throw-off area) The score is 30:30 with just four seconds left in the game. WHITE team scores to make it 31:30. BLACK team tries to take a quick throw-off. BLACK 10 stands with one foot behind the centre line and the other one just in front of it. Without a whistle signal, he throws the ball into the goal of WHITE team. The automatic signal from the public clock for the end of the game sounds. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the throw-off for BLACK team
Wait for the result of the throw
The game is over; no goal
questions.why: Correct: The game is over; no goal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.20, Rules 2:3, 2:4 and 15:5a.

questions.q: There is a free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team. WHITE 7 executes the free throw and, like his teammates, he is standing correctly outside the free-throw line. The free throw is executed quickly without a whistle signal, but before the ball has left the hand of WHITE 7, both WHITE 9 and WHITE 18 cross the free-throw line. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
Free throw for BLACK team; warning for WHITE 9 and WHITE 18
questions.why: Correct: Correction; Free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.21, Rule references: 13:7, 15:1, 15:5, 15:6, 15:7, 2nd paragraph.

questions.q: From which of the following throws is it not possible to score an own goal?
questions.why: Correct: Goalkeeper throw. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.22, Rules 12:2 and 15:2.

questions.q: BLACK 4 assumes a correct position to execute a throw-in that has been awarded to his team. As he cannot find a teammate to whom he could pass the ball he bounces the ball one time inside the sideline. Correct decision?
a: Free throw for WHITE team without whistle signal
Throw-in for WHITE team after restart signal
Repetition of the throw-in for BLACK team after whistle signal
Free throw for BLACK team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team without whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.23, Rules 15:2, 15:7 and 15:8.

questions.q: WHITE team receives a free throw. Without a whistle signal from the referees, WHITE 9 executes the free throw very quickly while jumping. The ball goes to WHITE 4, who finds himself completely unmarked in front of the goal of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: Repetition of the free throw for WHITE team after whistle signal. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.24, Rules 15:5b and 15:7.

questions.q: WHITE team receives a free throw. Without a whistle signal from the referees, WHITE 5 very quickly executes the free throw while running fast. WHITE 5 intends to play the ball to WHITE 4, but BLACK 3 intercepts the ball and finds himself unmarked in front of the goal of WHITE team. Correct decision?
a: Repetition of the free throw after whistle signal
Repetition of the free throw and progressive punishment for BLACK 3
questions.why: Correct: Game continues without interruption. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.25, Rule references: 13:2, 15:7, 2nd Paragraph.

questions.q: BLACK team is ready to execute a free throw without whistle signal. BLACK 8 executes the throw with both feet and his left hand in contact with the floor. BLACK 6 receives the ball and scores a goal. What is the correct decision?
a: Correction, repetition of the free throw after whistle signal from the referees
questions.why: Correct: Correction, repetition of the free throw after whistle signal from the referees. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.26, Rule references: 15:1, note.

questions.q: BLACK team score a goal. The referees whistle for the subsequent throw-off. Before the ball has left the hand of the thrower, there is a whistle signal from the timekeeper. WHITE 5 has entered the court before WHITE 6 has left the court. What is the correct decision?
a: Since the ball was out of play at the moment of the whistle the match is restarted with a throw-off for WHITE team.
The match is restarted with a free throw for BLACK team.
The match is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team.
questions.why: Correct: Time-out; 2-minute suspension for WHITE 5; The match is restarted with a free throw for BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 15.27, Rules 2:8, 4:4-6, 15:7 and 16:3a.

questions.q: Team official B from WHITE team is complaining and receives a 2-minute suspension. Before the game is restarted, he complains again and is therefore disqualified. Correct decision?
a: WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.1, Rule 16:9.

questions.q: WHITE 8 receives a 2-minute suspension, as he has pushed an opponent. He approaches the referee to insult him with the following words: “You are stupid, you are an idiot, you will never learn!” Before leaving the court he spits in the referee’s face. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 8, WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of WHITE 8, WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes (red card shown by the referees)
Disqualification of WHITE 8, WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
Disqualification of WHITE 8, WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 8, WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.2, Rules 8:10a, 16:6b and 16:9c.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of warnings that should be given to the officials of a team during a match?
questions.why: Correct: 1. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.3, Rule references: 16:1 comment.

questions.q: When does the suspension time of a player start?
a: When the referee gives the hand signal for the suspension
When the suspended player crosses the sideline
When the referee whistles for the game to be restarted
When the timekeeper starts the stopwatch
questions.why: Correct: When the referee whistles for the game to be restarted. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.4, Rule 16:5.

questions.q: To whom are suspensions to be indicated?
a: The suspended player and the scorekeeper/timekeeper
The responsible team official and the timekeeper
The suspended player, the responsible team official, and the scorekeeper
questions.why: Correct: The suspended player and the scorekeeper/timekeeper. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.5, Rule 16:4.

questions.q: BLACK 5 has received two 2-minute suspensions earlier in the game. One suspension for a foul that was punished progressively, and one for throwing the ball away, when the referees gave a free throw for the opponents. Now he commits his team’s second faulty substitution, and before the game is restarted, he commits an extremely unsportsmanlike conduct. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification for BLACK 5, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees; BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
Disqualification for BLACK 5, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for BLACK 5; Disqualification for BLACK 5, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees; BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.6, Rules 4:5, 8:10a, 16:3a, 16:6B, 16:6d and 16:9b.

questions.q: WHITE 5 receives a 2-minute suspension for a foul. While leaving the court he insults the referees and is disqualified. WHITE 5 then gets so upset that he hits one of the referees. Correct decision?
a: Written report (blue card shown by the referees)
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
questions.why: Correct: Written report (blue card shown by the referees); WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.7, Rule references: 8:10a, 16:6b 16:9c.

questions.q: WHITE 7 has just been suspended for two minutes for unfair play. Before the game is restarted, he says to the referee: “You must be blind, you idiot!” Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 7 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
Disqualification of WHITE 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes; Disqualification of WHITE 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.8, Rules 8:10a, 16:6b and 16:9c.

questions.q: WHITE 3 has been suspended for two minutes. After leaving the court, but before the restart of the match, WHITE 3 is guilty of a seriously unsportsmanlike conduct in the substitution area against official B from BLACK team. Just before that, official B from BLACK team ran out onto the playing court, even though no permission had been given. No sanctions have been called against the officials of BLACK team. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 3 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
Warning for official B from BLACK team
WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 3 without written report (red card shown by the referees); Warning for official B from BLACK team; WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.9, Rules 4:2, 8:9, 16:1b, 16:6b and 16:9c.

questions.q: When a player is disqualified, the team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes, unless the disqualification is given:
a: For seriously unsportsmanlike conduct during the half-time break
For an infringement outside the court
questions.why: Correct: Before the match begins. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.10, Rule 16:11b.

questions.q: During the half-time, break WHITE 7 assaults goalkeeper BLACK 12, while they are still on the court. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes at the beginning of the second half.
Caution for WHITE 7, because the match was interrupted
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes at the beginning of the second half. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.11, Rules 8:6, 16:6a, 16:10 and 17:10.

questions.q: During the half-time break, a referee is insulted by BLACK 7 on the way to the changing rooms. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 7 without written report (red card shown by the referees)
BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes at the beginning of the second half.
Disqualification of BLACK 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: BLACK team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes at the beginning of the second half; Disqualification of BLACK 7, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees). IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.12, Rules 8:10a, 16:6b, 16:10 and 17:10.

questions.q: After the whistle for half-time, BLACK 5 collides with WHITE 9 on the court, and they both start shouting at each other. WHITE 9 then pushes BLACK 5 in the chest with both hands, so that BLACK 5 almost loses body control. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 9 at the beginning of the second half
Disqualification of WHITE 9 without written report (red card shown by the referees); WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half.
Disqualification of WHITE 9; WHITE team starts the second half without reduction.
Disqualification of WHITE 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half.
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 9 without written report (red card shown by the referees); WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.13, Rules 8:9, 16:10 and 16:6b.

questions.q: After the game, WHITE 10 shouts at the referees: “You stole the game from us, you idiots!” Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 10, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
questions.why: Correct: Written report. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.14, Rule 16:11c.

questions.q: During the half-time break, WHITE 9, on the playing court, commits an assault against official B from BLACK team, who subsequently insults WHITE 9. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of WHITE 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half.

Disqualification of official B from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half.
Disqualification of WHITE 9 (red card shown by the referees); WHITE team will not be reduced from the beginning of the second half.
Disqualification of official B from BLACK team (red card shown by the referees); BLACK team will not be reduced from the beginning of the second half.
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of WHITE 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half; Disqualification of official B from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.15, Rules 8:10a, 16:6 and 16:10.

questions.q: WHITE 7 is disqualified because he has just received his third 2-minute suspension. He tries to argue with the referees and does not leave the court. Correct decision?
a: WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes.
WHITE team is reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes.
questions.why: Correct: WHITE team is reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.16, Rule 16:9b.

questions.q: WHITE 11 was warned in the first half and is again guilty of unsportsmanlike conduct during the half-time break. WHITE team was playing at full strength on the court, when the first half ended. Correct decision?
a: WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half.
WHITE team will not be reduced by players on the court from the beginning of the second half.
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for WHITE 11; WHITE team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes from the beginning of the second half. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.17, Rules 16:3d, 16:5 and 16:10.

questions.q: WHITE 4 is injured. The referees whistle for a time-out and give the hand signal to permit WHITE team to enter the court and take care of the player. Officials A and B from WHITE team, but also official A from BLACK team, enter the court. Official A from BLACK team already received a warning. Correct decision?
a: When the game is restarted, BLACK team continues with the same number of players on the court as before the interruption.
2-minute suspension for official A from BLACK team
Disqualification of official A from BLACK team (red card shown by the referees)
When the game is restarted, BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes.
After receiving medical care on the court, WHITE 4 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team.
questions.why: Correct: 2-minute suspension for official A from BLACK team; When the game is restarted, BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 2 minutes; After receiving medical care on the court, WHITE 4 must leave the court and can only re-enter following the third attack of his team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.18, Rule references: 4:11, 16:3e, 16:3 comment, Clarification 8c.

questions.q: BLACK 9 is given a disqualification because of a serious foul against WHITE 9. Before the game is restarted, BLACK 9 hits official A from WHITE team in the face. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of BLACK 9 without written report (red card shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes.
Disqualification of BLACK 9 without written report (red card shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes.
Disqualification of BLACK 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes.
Disqualification of BLACK 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes.
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of BLACK 9, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.19, Rules 8:10a and 16:9d.

questions.q: BLACK 8 is given his first 2-minute suspension following a time-out signal. When he leaves the court, before the game is restarted, he addresses the referees in an unsportsmanlike manner. Correct decision?
a: An additional 2-minute suspension for BLACK 8, BLACK team will be reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
An additional 2-minute suspension for BLACK 8, BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
Disqualification of BLACK 8 (red card shown by the referees), BLACK team will be reduced by 2 players on the court for 2 minutes
Disqualification of BLACK 8 (red card shown by the referees), BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes
questions.why: Correct: An additional 2-minute suspension for BLACK 8, BLACK team will be reduced by 1 player on the court for 4 minutes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 16.20, Rules 8:7a, 16:3d and 16:9a.

questions.q: The referees disagree on which team should have a throw-in. How should this be handled?
a: The two referees make a joint decision after consultation.
No time-out, but throw-in executed after whistle signal
questions.why: Correct: The two referees make a joint decision after consultation; Time-out. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.1, Rules 2:8d and 17:7.

questions.q: The automatic final signal from the public clock is not working. The timekeeper has not noticed the problem and therefore does not react, even though the playing time has already ended. Who shall give the final signal in this case?
a: Either the timekeeper, the delegate or one of the referees
questions.why: Correct: Either the timekeeper, the delegate or one of the referees. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.2, Rules 2:3 and 17:9.

questions.q: BLACK 2 has committed an infraction. The court referee decides on a disqualification of BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees) and a free throw. The goal referee decides on a 2-minute suspension for BLACK 2 and a 7-metre throw. How is BLACK 2 to be penalised, and how is the game to be continued?
a: If no joint decision is reached, 2-minute suspension for BLACK 2
If no joint decision is reached, disqualification of BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees)
If no joint decision is reached, free throw
If no joint decision is reached, 7-metre throw
The referees must try to reach a joint decision
questions.why: Correct: If no joint decision is reached, disqualification of BLACK 2 (red card shown by the referees); If no joint decision is reached, 7-metre throw; The referees must try to reach a joint decision. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.3, Rule 17:6.

questions.q: In case of doubt, who decides about the accuracy of the timekeeping?
a: The two referees reach a joint decision.
The two referees and the timekeeper reach a joint decision.
questions.why: Correct: The two referees reach a joint decision. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.4, Rule 17:9.

questions.q: Which punishments need to be explained in the match report?
a: All disqualifications, except for those given because of three 2-minute suspensions
Disqualifications for dangerous fouls or seriously unsportsmanlike conduct in the last 30 seconds of the match, if the action is intended to prevent the opponents from creating a scoring chance
Disqualification due to extremely unsportsmanlike conduct
Any progressive punishment during the last 30 seconds of the game, if the action is intended to prevent the opponents from creating a scoring chance
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification due to extremely unsportsmanlike conduct. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.5, Rules 8:5, 8:10a-b, 16:6 and 17:10.

questions.q: Who is entitled to address the referees during a game?
questions.why: Correct: The responsible team official. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.6, Rules 4:2 and 17:11.

questions.q: The referees have different opinions about how much playing time remains. The goal-line referee (first mentioned referee) believes that 50 seconds remain, while the court referee believes that 42 seconds remain. Correct decision?
a: The longer playing time applies (50 seconds).
The first mentioned referee decides (50 seconds).
The two referees must reach a joint decision.
questions.why: Correct: The two referees must reach a joint decision. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.7, Rule 17:9.

questions.q: At the start of a match, which referee becomes the court referee, and which referee becomes the goal-line referee?
a: The first mentioned referee becomes the court referee.
The first mentioned referee becomes the goal-line referee.
The referees use a coin toss to decide, who starts where.
The referees are free to make their own choice.
questions.why: Correct: The referees are free to make their own choice. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.8, Rule 17:1.

questions.q: The two referees whistle after a collision between two players. The court referee shows offensive foul, but the goal-line referee indicates a violation by the defender. How should this be decided?
a: The decision of the goal-line referee is valid.
The decision of the court referee is valid.
The referees contact each other to reach a joint decision.
Time-out only necessary if the joint decision goes against the attacking team
Time-out not obligatory, if the referees are using electronic equipment for their internal communication
questions.why: Correct: The referees contact each other to reach a joint decision; Time-out is obligatory. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 17.9, Rule 17:7.

questions.q: What do the Rules of the Game prescribe regarding the work distribution between timekeeper and scorekeeper?
a: The control of the entry and exit of the substitutes is handled only by the timekeeper.
Generally, only the timekeeper should interrupt the game, when this becomes necessary.
The scorekeeper must whistle, if he observes that a substitute enters the court too soon.
If there is no public clock, the timekeeper keeps the teams informed about how much time has been played or how much time remains.
Counting the number of attacks when a player is serving 3 attacks after receiving medical care on the court is a shared task for the timekeeper and scorekeeper.
questions.why: Correct: Generally, only the timekeeper should interrupt the game, when this becomes necessary; If there is no public clock, the timekeeper keeps the teams informed about how much time has been played or how much time remains; Counting the number of attacks when a player is serving 3 attacks after receiving medical care on the court is a shared task for the timekeeper and scorekeeper. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.1, Rules 18:1 and 18:2.

questions.q: WHITE 5 has a clear chance of scoring. Team official A from WHITE team insults the timekeeper. The timekeeper whistles just when WHITE 5 is about to shoot. The action has been noticed only by the timekeeper. Correct decision?
a: Punishment against team official A from WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Free throw for WHITE team; Written report. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.2, Rule references: Clarification 7.

questions.q: The responsible team official from WHITE team insults the scorekeeper, without this being noticed by the referees or a delegate. During the next interruption of the game, the scorekeeper informs the referees about what has happened. Correct decision?
a: Disqualification of the responsible team official from WHITE team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
2-minute suspension for the responsible team official of WHITE team
Warning for the responsible team official from WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: Written report; No personal punishment possible. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.3, Rule references: 18:1, Clarification 7B.

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball at the free-throw line of BLACK team. The technical delegate interrupts the game and explains to the referees that official A from BLACK team has insulted him. Correct decision?
a: Caution for official A from BLACK team, written report
Disqualification of official A from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees)
The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team at the substitution area of BLACK team.
The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team.
questions.why: Correct: Disqualification of official A from BLACK team, written report (red and blue cards shown by the referees); The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.4, Rule references: 8:10a, 13:6, 16:6b, Clarification 7B, Substitution Area Regulations 5.

questions.q: WHITE team is in possession of the ball at the free-throw line of BLACK team. The timekeeper interrupts the game and explains to the referees that official A from WHITE team has insulted him. The action has been noticed only by the timekeeper. Correct decision?
a: 2-minute suspension for official A from WHITE team, written report
The game is restarted with a free throw for BLACK team at the substitution area of WHITE team.
The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team.
questions.why: Correct: Written report; The game is restarted with a free throw for WHITE team at the free-throw line of BLACK team. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.5, Rule references: 13:4a, Clarification 7B.

questions.q: During the match, official A from WHITE team repeatedly moves to the timekeeper’s desk to coach right next to it. While doing so he protests over referee decisions. Due to the noise in the playing hall, the referees do not notice this. Correct decision?
a: The timekeeper immediately interrupts the game and informs the referees about official A’s misbehaviour.
The timekeeper waits until the next interruption of the game and informs the referees about official A’s misbehaviour.
Progressive punishment for official A from WHITE team
questions.why: Correct: The timekeeper waits until the next interruption of the game and informs the referees about official A’s misbehaviour; No punishment possible. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.6, Rule references: Clarification 7B, Substitution Area Regulations 5.

questions.q: When should the timekeeper/scorekeeper inform the referees about a violation of the Substitution Area Regulations that has not been noticed by the referees?
a: At the time of the next interruption of the game
questions.why: Correct: At the time of the next interruption of the game. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.7, Rule references: Clarification 7B.

questions.q: If the technical delegate interrupts the game because of a violation by WHITE team when the ball is in play, the game is restarted with ball possession by BLACK team. Correct?
questions.why: Correct: Yes. IHF Catalogue 2025, question 18.8, Rule references: Clarification 7B.
